verified: Business-development outreach is a repeated part of CA's working context.
Evidenced work includes prospect research, commercial pitch development, opportunity meetings, external stakeholder coordination, POC/activation planning and presentation preparation.
Prospect outreach should be short, personal and human, without inflated corporate wording or filler.
Premium-prospect wording can be polished and executive while remaining natural and specific.
The newer 2026-06-03 prospecting direction is to focus general outreach on commercials/high-end commercial production rather than leading with generic social-media management.
Where an opportunity is genuinely for ongoing marketing support, CG can be positioned as the prospect's external marketing team / extension of the internal team.
Formal meetings, portfolio presentations and concrete creative discussions are preferred over vague collaboration language.
Creative copy should be specific and non-generic; captions should add to artwork rather than repeat it.
Use natural everyday Afrikaans when Afrikaans is requested.
Do not use em dashes in captions.
Avoid repetitive formulaic openings and mechanical three-claim sentence patterns.
Provide multiple genuinely different creative options by default unless one is requested.
Include a focused relevant hashtag set with social captions unless the client/request says otherwise.
Keep assistant replies concise and operational; use live company sources proactively; help close completed work in the relevant live system when authorised.
Never create a shadow CRM/task system and never expose development tooling in the normal CA staff workflow.
